description: This file defines classes related to SubPanel management in a SugarCRM-derived CRM system, including 'aSubPanel' for individual subpanels and 'SubPanelDefinitions' for managing multiple subpanels, their layout, ACL checks, and metadata loading.

classes.name: aSubPanel
classes.description: Represents a subpanel within the CRM, handling loading of layout definitions, data sources, permissions, and display properties.

classes.name: SubPanelDefinitions
classes.description: Manages a collection of subpanels for a given focus bean, including loading layouts, filtering, and ACL-based visibility.

methods.name: aSubPanel::__construct
methods.description: Constructs a subpanel instance, loading its layout and metadata, and determining if it can be displayed.

methods.name: aSubPanel::buildSearchQuery
methods.description: Builds search where clause for filtering subpanel data based on module-specific search definitions.

methods.name: aSubPanel::isDefaultHidden
methods.description: Checks if the subpanel is marked as hidden by default.

methods.name: aSubPanel::distinct_query
methods.description: Indicates whether the subpanel query needs to be distinct.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_title
methods.description: Returns the translated title for the subpanel header.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_buttons
methods.description: Retrieves button definitions for the subpanel, applying permission-based filtering.

methods.name: aSubPanel::load_sub_subpanels
methods.description: Loads nested sub-subpanels if applicable, handling metadata and permissions.

methods.name: aSubPanel::getDisplayFieldsFromCollection
methods.description: Collects display fields across a collection of sub-subpanels.

methods.name: aSubPanel::isDatasourceFunction
methods.description: Checks if the subpanel's data source is a callable function.

methods.name: aSubPanel::isCollection
methods.description: Determines if this subpanel is based on a collection type.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_inst_prop_value
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the instance's metadata properties.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_def_prop_value
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the panel's definition array.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_function_parameters
methods.description: Returns parameters for the data source function, if applicable.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_data_source_name
methods.description: Returns the data source identifier for the subpanel, handling functions or static definitions.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_where
methods.description: Constructs the WHERE clause for querying subpanel data, including search filters.

methods.name: aSubPanel::is_fill_in_additional_fields
methods.description: Determines if additional fields should be filled in for the subpanel.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_list_fields
methods.description: Returns the list field definitions for the subpanel layout.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_module_name
methods.description: Gets the module name associated with the subpanel.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_name
methods.description: Returns the subpanel's name.

methods.name: aSubPanel::load_module_info
methods.description: Loads module information such as table name and bean instance for the subpanel.

methods.name: aSubPanel::get_header_panel_def
methods.description: Gets the header definition for the subpanel, including nested headers.

methods.name: aSubPanel::_to_array
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the subpanel's current properties.

methods.name: aSubPanel::set_panel_definition
methods.description: Sets the panel's layout definition from metadata.

methods.name: SubPanelDefinitions::__construct
methods.description: Constructs the collection of subpanels for a focus bean, loading or overriding layout definitions.

methods.name: SubPanelDefinitions::get_available_tabs
methods.description: Returns a list of subpanel tabs that are accessible via ACL, optionally including titles.

methods.name: SubPanelDefinitions::load_subpanel
methods.description: Loads a specific subpanel by name, respecting display permissions and layout definitions.

methods.name: SubPanelDefinitions::open_layout_defs
methods.description: Loads layout definitions from metadata files, optional reload and override.

methods.name: SubPanelDefinitions::exclude_tab
methods.description: Removes a tab from the layout and visible tabs.

methods.name: SubPanelDefinitions::get_all_subpanels
methods.description: Returns a list of all subpanels across modules, optionally filtered by module and grouped.

methods.name: SubPanelDefinitions::set_hidden_subpanels
methods.description: Saves hidden subpanel list to user preferences.

methods.name: SubPanelDefinitions::get_hidden_subpanels
methods.description: Retrieves list of hidden subpanels from user preferences.
